integrity: The claim is supported by a direct proof, explicit parameter inequalities and a reproducible exact-arithmetic checker; numerical sampling is not used to certify the infinite parameter ranges.
scientific_limitations: Local full-state stability of the unique positive synchronous primitive two-cycle only; no global positive-octant invariance, nonsynchronous cycle census or nonlinear classification at neutral boundaries. An inaccessible 1987 three-dimensional cyclic Lotka–Volterra paper leaves a publication-priority risk.
title: Sharp reentrant transverse stability of synchronous two-cycles in a three-species Lotka–Volterra map
